description: Slide masters and layouts: a layout placeholder's prompt text, Insert > Header & Footer, adding, duplicating, renaming or deleting layouts and adding their placeholders. Their shapes' text, fill and box: ppt_set_text, ppt_set_shape (L2.5, M0.7); new shapes: the add tools with slide L2 or M0. Returns the slides affected.

date.description: set_footer: auto (updates), fixed text, or leave out for none.

reassign_to.description: delete_layout: the layout its slides move to.

slides.description: set_footer: only these slides (Apply), numbers or ids (s:256). Default all (Apply to All: masters and layouts too). add_placeholder: also add it to these.

target.description: set_prompt: the layout placeholder, L2.3. Layout actions: the layout, L2 or its name (add_layout: the one to follow; add_placeholder: or L2.7 to add to slides).

text.description: set_prompt: the prompt, \n for the next level. set_footer: the footer; empty: none. Other actions: the name.

name: ppt_edit_master
